chunks: My father narrated to us, may God be pleased with him, saying: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated to us, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from more than one person, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The age of puberty for a woman is nine years.
ai.seo_question: What is the age of puberty for women according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *al-Khisal* establishes the baseline age of puberty (bulugh) for females as nine lunar years, a ruling derived from the physical signs of maturity rather than chronological age alone. In Shia jurisprudence, this threshold signifies the onset of *taklif* (religious accountability), making the female liable for prayers, fasting, and other duties, while also influencing rules regarding marriage and financial independence.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 9-17 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim quoted his father, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, on the authority of several others that Aba Abdullah as-Sadiq (MGB) said,
“The age of puberty for women is nine.”
